- **Now** — Backend engineer at **[Trames](https://trames.io)**, working mainly with TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL and AWS.
- **Building** — **[Orbica](https://orbica.space)**, an open space encyclopedia covering rockets, satellites and launches since 1957, with live 3D orbital tracking.
- **Before** — Built and shipped backend systems serving **~200K users** at Thaagam Foundation, using Django, PostgreSQL, Redis and the WhatsApp Business API.
- **Studying** — Finishing an MCA alongside full-time engineering work.
